 U.S. Marine Corps Col. Trevor Felter, center, commanding officer, Marine Corps Air Station Beaufort, briefs Sgt. Dakota L. Meyer, center-left, senior enlisted advisor to the Secretary of War's barracks task force, during a tour at MCAS Beaufort, South Carolina, Oct. 30, 2026. Meyer visited MCAS Beaufort to discuss barracks renovations and upcoming changes while engaging with Marines to hear their concerns and gain insight into their living conditions, (Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Carl J. Walters)
